articles.summary: Centerspace (NYSE: CSR) (the "Company") will release its operating results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on Monday, November 2, 2026. Due to the Company's previously announced merger with Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT), the Company will not host a conference call regarding its third quarter 2026 operating results. About Centerspace Centerspace is an owner and operator of apartment communities committed to providing great homes by focusing on integrity and serving others. Founded in 1970, as of September 30, 2026, Centerspace owned 47 apartment communities consisting of 10,456 homes located in Colorado, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, and Utah. Centerspace was named a Top Workplace in 2026 by USA Today and for the seventh consecutive year in 2026 by the Minnesota Star Tribune. For more information, please visit www.centerspacehomes.com .
